entities.name: D-alanine--D-alanine ligase
observations: The 366-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt entry Q10X06 from Trichodesmium erythraeum; identity and coverage are 100%.
Curated function is ATP-dependent ligation of two D-alanine molecules to form D-alanyl-D-alanine; EC 6.3.2.4 and Rhea RHEA:11224.
